quote: The fact that the speed of a vehicle is lower than the prescribed limits does not relieve a driver from the duty to decrease speed when approaching and crossing an intersection, when approaching and going around a curve, when approaching a hill crest, when traveling upon any narrow or winding highway, or when special hazards exist or may exist with respect to pedestrians or other traffic, or by reason of weather or other highway conditions, and speed must be decreased as may be necessary to avoid colliding with any person, vehicle or other conveyance on or entering a highway in compliance with legal requirements and the duty of all persons to use due care.

activation.description: Driver approaches or crosses an intersection, approaches or travels around a curve or crest, travels on a narrow or winding highway, or faces listed special hazards.
activation.source_clause: when approaching and crossing an intersection, when approaching and going around a curve, when approaching a hill crest, when traveling upon any narrow or winding highway, or when special hazards exist or may exist

obligation.description: Decrease speed to the extent necessary to avoid collision while exercising due care; being under a prescribed limit does not discharge the duty.
obligation.source_clause: speed must be decreased as may be necessary to avoid colliding

timing.description: Assess the approach and crossing or hazard encounter, including speed reduction before conflict exposure.
timing.source_clause: when approaching and crossing an intersection

judgment_calls_needed.note: The necessary reduction depends on the actual collision hazard and due-care context, not a fixed mph threshold.
Whether all relevant persons used due care requires independent source and legal review.
